name: Artellum
description: Wall pieces, tea lights, door hangings and keychains, painted by hand in dots, small mirrors and lettering. See every piece, and every colour it comes in.

hero.title: Painted by hand, dot by dot.
hero.line: Wall pieces, tea lights, door hangings and keychains by Artellum, worked in dots, small mirrors and lettering.

maker.title: Hello, I’m the hands behind Artellum.
body: I paint, crochet and make small things for walls from a corner of my home that is slowly turning into a studio. Everything here is made by me, by hand.
Paintings and most wall pieces are one of a kind. The small things are made to order, so they can be made and customized just for you.

askLines.wall-pieces: Most wall pieces are one of a kind.
askLines.default: Made to order, and it can be changed to suit you.

categoryLines.wall-pieces: Round plates, mirrors and panels, worked in dots and small inset mirrors, some lettered in Devanagari.
categoryLines.tea-lights: Holders for a single tea light, in petals, paisleys and rings of dots. Every design comes in a run of colours.
categoryLines.door-hangings: Lotus hangings on strings of pearls with tassels, and shubh labh pairs for either side of a door.
categoryLines.keychains: Small painted keychains: lotus flowers, round hearts with faces, and a bride and groom.

lettering.means: good fortune and gain, a pair for either side of a door
the name of Radha, with the honorific shri
with you to protect me, why fear anyone; a line from the Hanuman Chalisa
